messages:
Omar (SRE): Postmortem linked: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-05-batch-latency. Follow-ups: SLO update + action owners.
Lena P: TL;DR: large P99/P99.9 spikes during 02:50-03:10 UTC batch window; avg latency SLO hides it. Error budget burn hit 35% this week.
Omar (SRE): Proposal: add route_p99_9 SLO <= 1200ms at 99.6% and a sustained_throughput SLI (5m rolling avg >= 90% baseline). Keep a 14-day validation window in shadow before SLA changes.
Lena P: PromQL for p99.9 (5m):
```
histogram_quantile(0.999, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
```
Throughput SLI (5m avg):
```
avg_over_time(sum(rate(requests_total[1m])) by (route)[5m:1m])
```
Omar (SRE): Action owners:
- Lena P: update SLO docs + prepare PM/legal note (due 2026-05-08)
- Omar: create alert rules + push to staging (due 2026-05-06)
- Infra: add jitter and tenant caps for heavy batch jobs (due 2026-05-10)
infra-bot: Observed pattern: batch-window 02:45-03:15 UTC across 6 tenants last 10 days. Pattern-id: b2026-05-A.
sre-oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0504-01 posted. Assigned Omar.
Lena P: Also recommending tiered error-budget paging: enterprise pages at >30% weekly burn, startups alert-only. Add predictive burn slope alert (slope >8%/day).
Omar (SRE): I'll open tracking ticket RED-4520 and add owners/dates. Meeting to sign off on SLO numbers after validation: 2026-05-22 10:00 UTC. React :white_check_mark: if you accept.
Lena P: :white_check_mark: accepting.
Omar (SRE): Thanks. I'll log runbook note: "Batch window mitigation" with steps: tenant caps, fallback routing, temporary scale.
infra-bot: Runbook update queued.
Omar (SRE): Closing thread, will update postmortem with SLO proposal link and ticket.
